description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haloya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320049
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership transfers, and title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
